question: v11
q: When does the CBD empty out on a Friday compared with midweek?

transcript.answer:
**Short answer:** The CBD empties earlier on a Friday, mostly between 4pm and 6pm. The 5pm peak is where it shows most. Friday tap-ons then run about a third below midweek. Midday is the same as midweek.

These figures are Opal tap-ons per hour in Sydney CBD, averaged over the last 12 months. I took "midweek" as the Tuesday to Thursday average and worked out the ratios myself from the hourly profiles.

| Hour | Midweek (Tue–Thu) | Friday | Friday vs midweek |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7am | ~13,000 | ~10,900 | 0.84 |
| 8am | ~23,000 | ~18,000 | 0.78 |
| 9am | ~16,700 | ~15,500 | 0.93 |
| 12–2pm | ~22,200–31,600 | ~23,000–32,100 | ~1.02–1.03 |
| 3pm | ~43,000 | ~41,100 | 0.95 |
| 4pm | ~65,500 | ~51,900 | 0.79 |
| **5pm (peak)** | **~95,300** | **~64,600** | **0.68** |
| 6pm | ~51,600 | ~40,800 | 0.79 |
| 7pm | ~27,600 | ~25,200 | 0.91 |
| 10pm | ~12,400 | ~19,600 | 1.58 |
| 11pm | ~5,550 | ~11,300 | 2.04 |

- **Timing:** Friday is level with midweek through lunch and about 5% lower at 3pm. It drops to about 79% of midweek at 4pm and about 68% at 5pm. It is still lower at 6pm (about 79%) and nearly back to midweek by 7pm (about 91%).
- **Morning:** Friday arrivals are also lighter. The 8am peak is about 22% below midweek.
- **Night:** Friday late-night taps are well above midweek, at about 1.6× at 10pm and 2× at 11pm. That suggests people go home and come back in for the evening, or stay in the city for the night.

**Overall gap:** For 3–7pm, Friday volume was 0.783 of the Tuesday to Thursday average in September 2026. It has stayed between 0.744 and 0.799 since September 2025. Before COVID (6 Jan–6 Mar 2020) it was 0.905.

**Pre-COVID shape:** Friday has always been a bit lighter. At 5pm it was about 85% of midweek, against about 68% now. At 4pm it was about 97%, against about 79% now.

The data may not include Sydney Metro taps in the CBD. That could understate absolute levels compared with 2020, but the Friday-to-midweek ratios within a period aren't affected.
